name: report_render
title: Render a past run to another format
description:
Renders a stored run to another file format without calling any tool again (a report is a snapshot). Only your own runs, or any run for an administrator.
Returns: run_id, format, path (in the storage backend), bytes; content too for markdown.
Inputs (* required): run_id*; format* (markdown, html, pdf, xlsx, pptx, docx; a format whose package is not installed fails saying which).
Example: {"run_id": "desk_calendar-20261011T120000000-a1b2c3", "format": "html"}

run_id.description: A run id as report_<name>, report_run or report_history return it
